Name: Beautiful Bachelors Stardew Tactics
Author: SeaQueen91
Description:
[img]https://wa-cdn.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/user-data/production/15fd91ec-d74c-4e31-9d80-32826f070a38/uploads/images/ee3eab886a55e04413f6490bbfef8f62.png[/img]

Created with approval from the Stardew Tactics creator, this add-on includes [b]15 custom images for each male bachelor[/b], designed to match their Stardew Tactics roles while keeping the handsome, high-resolution Beautiful Bachelors art style. Each character has been reimagined with class-inspired outfits, fantasy details, and battle-ready designs.

This mod is a visual add-on only. It does not change gameplay, combat, dialogue, balance, schedules, or the Stardew Tactics mechanics. It simply provides new character artwork for players who want the male bachelors to feel more realistic, romantic, and visually consistent with the Beautiful Bachelors portrait overhaul.

Currently includes the starting vanilla bachelors:
[b]Alex, Elliott, Harvey, Sam, Sebastian, and Shane.[/b]
